player_prompt.intro:
Ikaw so Player {player_id} ed say game na Indian Poker.
- 52-card deck; nakita mo so card na opponent.
- Ante {ante} chip(s) cada round, {max_rounds} round(s) total.
- Valid moves: '[check]'  |  '[bet X]'  |  '[call]'  |  '[raise X]'  |  '[fold]'  (X et say positive integer <= say chip count mo.)
- Highest hidden card wins so pot na showdown.

round.announce:
### Round {current_round}/{max_rounds}
Say card na opponent mo: {card}

invalid_move.ambiguous: Suppilan ya agya exactamente ONE bracketed action, e.g. '[check]', '[bet 2]', '[call]', '[raise 3]', o '[fold]'.
invalid_move.cannot_check: Cannot [check] - you are facing a bet.
invalid_move.amount_min: Say bet / raise et nepeg ya ≥ 1.
invalid_move.no_bet_to_raise: Usaren so [bet X] pian lukasan; anggapo lay bet ya iyatagey.

message.showdown_tie: Say pan-shootdown et nankapareho: pareho {card}. Naapag so banga na balang sakey ed sikara, mangawat ira na {split} .

outcome.draw: Parehon chips kayari na amin a round.
